component.name: LinkHub
component.summary: Universal Device Ecosystem: Connect Windows, Linux, and Android

description.p: LinkHub connects your computers and smartphones in a single unified workspace over a secure local peer-to-peer mesh.

ul.li: Universal bidirectional clipboard sync for text, URLs, and images
Mirror notifications and reply inline across all connected devices
Direct peer-to-peer file transfer and browsable storage with resume support
Low-latency remote screen, camera, and audio streaming
Seamless mouse and keyboard forwarding across screens
Integrated telephony, calls, and SMS messaging
